title.en: An Act Appropriating Funds for Public Works
title.orig: An Act Amending Item Sixty-Four of Subsection (A) of Section One of Republic Act Numbered Six Hundred Seventy, Entitled “An Act Appropriating Funds for Public Works”

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1955/ra_1217_1955.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Item 64 for Quezon Province (page 105) of subsection (a) of section one of Republic Act Numbered Six hundred seventy, entitled "An Act Appropriating Funds for Public Works," is hereby amended to read as follows:
"64. For the construction of a waterworks system in Polo, Padre Burgos ₱10,000.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: May 10, 1955.
